why: Go, a repository where a bot is one of the most active committers: Dependabot opened 6 of the 60 episodes in the window and its own CI (`gh-aw` agentic workflows) is generated and recompiled in tree, which is exactly the terrain `generated_edit` and the dependency axes have to be right about. It is also the only one of the three with a non-trivial agent-attributed population (20 of 60 episodes attribute to an author kind other than `human`), and the guardrail is meant for agent-driven work.
pinned_by: looprs (e4.9, 2026-10-19): `git clone --depth 140 --single-branch <url>` then `python3 tools/fetch_g3_corpus.py` from this pin; head is the branch tip at the time of the pass and the window is the 60 newest episodes above it. `pinned_now` is a fixed instant above every commit date in the window, because the harness's clock is a field and never a read.
